title: bawf-1997b-big-apple-heavyweight
label: "Bullseye" Shawn Arrows

won.source: The fed's own 27 February 1998 broadcast recalls Arrows winning the title on this date, before the held record begins.

note: Retained by disqualification against Rob Atlas earlier the same night before a stipulated restart ended the reign by pinfall.

lost.note: Loses the title to Sephiroth at a point not attested in the held record, which finds Sephiroth already champion by the fed's own 22 May 1998 broadcast.
Loses the title to "Sexy" Rex Harley at a point not attested in the held record; Harley is already champion entering the fed's own 12 April 1998 broadcast.

title: bawf-1997b-television
label: Jimmy "Pretty Boy" Floyd

lost.note: Loses the title to "Offspring" Aaron Oakley at a point not attested in the held record; the fed's own 4 May 1998 broadcast already describes Floyd as "a two-time former BAWF Television Champion."

note: A second reign for this holder; an earlier, undated first reign is referenced but not otherwise attested in the held record.

title: bawf-1997b-manhattan
label: Spellbinder

won.source: Already Manhattan Heavyweight Champion entering the held record's 29 January 1998 broadcast; retained against Shotgun Smith on 27 February 1998 after an overturned Jason Jinx interference finish.

note: The wrestler who won that match, "Offspring" Aaron Oakley, advanced in a bracket tournament for the vacant title rather than becoming champion himself; the tournament's own semi-final round on 4 May 1998 narrowed the field to Shawn "Bullseye" Arrows and "Sexy" Rex Harley. The tournament's own final does not survive in the fed's own held broadcasts.

title: bawf-1997b-big-apple-heavyweight
label: Sephiroth

won.source: Not attested to a date in the held record.

note: The fed's own 18 May 1998 broadcast records a first title defense, against Jimmy "Pretty Boy" Floyd, thrown out without a fall after the champion collapses mid-match; the champion retains and a rematch inside a steel cage is ordered.

title: bawf-1997b-television
label: Troy Croft

won.source: A recap clip aired on the fed's own 18 May 1998 broadcast credits this win to a match against "Offspring" Aaron Oakley at that date's Mayday Massacre supercard; the match itself is not otherwise captured in the held record of that show.

note: A title match against the winner of this same broadcast's Dream Partners tag bout, Lord Wrath, is set for the following week's broadcast, not itself held in the held record.

title: bawf-1997b-manhattan
label: "Bullseye" Shawn Arrows

won.source: Not attested to a date in the held record.

note: A tournament for the vacant title carried Arrows through a semi-final win over Lord Wrath on the fed's own 4 May 1998 broadcast, setting up a final against the tournament's other semi-final winner, "Sexy" Rex Harley. The fed's own 9 May 1998 joint broadcast frames a Manhattan Heavyweight Championship match as up for grabs that night and shows Harley's own crew assaulting Arrows backstage beforehand; the match itself, and its result, do not survive in the fed's own held broadcast of that card. Arrows is already billed as champion on the fed's own next surviving broadcast, 18 May 1998.

won.source: Already Big Apple Tag Team Champions entering the held record's 5 February 1998 broadcast; retained against the New Revolution on 27 February 1998.
